title: When creating a HID report item, set usages to an empty array if isRange is true
body:
This is a followup to #140.

Under the [HIDReportItem dictionary](https://hid.spec.whatwg.org/#hidreportitem-dictionary) section, `usages` is defined as

> If [isRange](https://hid.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-hidreportitem-isrange) is true or this item has no associated [HID usage](https://hid.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-hid-usages) values, then [usages](https://hid.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-hidreportitem-usages) MUST be undefined.
> If [isRange](https://hid.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-hidreportitem-isrange) is false then [usages](https://hid.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-hidreportitem-usages) is a [sequence](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-sequence) of [HID usage](https://hid.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-hid-usages) values associated with this item.

I think it would be clearer and easier to handle for clients if, when `isRange` is false but there are no associated HID usages, we made `usages` be set to an empty array instead of undefined. So something like:

> If [isRange](https://hid.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-hidreportitem-isrange) is true, then [usages](https://hid.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-hidreportitem-usages) MUST be undefined.
>If [isRange](https://hid.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-hidreportitem-isrange) is false then [usages](https://hid.spec.whatwg.org/#dom-hidreportitem-usages) is a [sequence](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#idl-sequence) of [HID usage](https://hid.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-hid-usages) values associated with this item, which may be empty.
